title: The Pale Harvest
journal: Nesh-Deeka sent me to the wreck of the Pale Harvest in Hatandros Bight, a short swim out from Ysan's jetty. I'm to get into the hold, where the drowned crew walk, and open the captain's strongbox. I may fight them or steal past and pick its lock; the captain carries its key.
objectives: Open the captain's strongbox in the wreck of the Pale Harvest. (marker: Captain's Strongbox, Drowned Captain, Ysan Jetty)

plan.going: The silver setting named the Pale Harvest, a wreck that may hold the next clue to the Eye.
plan.next: Travel by boat to Thorn, walk to Ysan's jetty, swim to the wreck and open the captain's strongbox.
plan.ways: Fight the drowned crew and take the captain's key, or sneak past them and pick the strongbox's Adept lock.
terms: Hatandros Bight and Ysan: journal 10: the bay, and the landing with the stone jetty

answers: I work for Nesh-Deeka of the Toh-Reel-Ka. The Old Silver Setting named the Pale Harvest, a sunk Company freighter, which may hold the real Eye of Argonia, needed to heal the Hist trees. The Unbound and the Collector also hunt it.
Get into the wreck of the Pale Harvest in Hatandros Bight (a short swim from Ysan Jetty), get past the drowned crew in the hold, and open the captain's strongbox.
Fight the drowned crew, or sneak past and pick the strongbox lock, or take the key from the Drowned Captain. Quiet is favoured, so sneaking and lockpicking.
I do not fully understand why the crew are drowned and still walking; I could learn by looking around and talking or reading things in the wreck.

title: The Pale Harvest
journal: In the captain's strongbox lay a keystone on a chain, carved in a style I do not know. I'm to bring it to Nesh-Deeka in her house in Helstrom.
objectives: Bring the keystone to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. (marker: Nesh-Deeka)

plan.going: I have a keystone from the wreck; I do not know what it opens.
plan.next: Bring it to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom, by boat back up the rivers.

answers: I stole the captain's key and opened the strongbox on the Pale Harvest wreck without a fight. It held a Kothringi Keystone on a chain, not the Eye itself, but presumably a step toward it. I work for Nesh-Deeka.
Bring the keystone to Nesh-Deeka in her house in Helstrom.
Go straight there; I could also look at the keystone or the wreck more first, or keep it, but the journal says to deliver it. I do not know of other options.
I do not know what Kothringi means or what the keystone does or opens. I could ask Nesh-Deeka or others.

title: The Pale Harvest
journal: Nesh-Deeka did not know the keystone, but it is of Kothringi make (the Kothringi were the silver-skinned people of the marsh, all dead of the Knahaten Flu long ago), and the Chime-Keepers of Toklea keep what is left of Kothringi lore. She already knew the Unbound had not found the wreck. When I asked how, she said "we listen" and talked of Toklea instead. She paid me 100 gold.

plan.going: The keystone is Kothringi; the Chime-Keepers of Toklea may know what it opens. Nesh-Deeka again knew where the Unbound had or had not been.
plan.next: MN08 starts; its first entry marks Toklea.
terms: Kothringi: Nesh-Deeka: the silver-skinned people of the marsh, dead of the Knahaten Flu
the Chime-Keepers of Toklea: Nesh-Deeka: the town that keeps Kothringi lore

answers: Notes for a friend picking up my save: I am a Voh-Vastei of the Toh-Reel-Ka under Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. The Pale Harvest quest is complete. I stole the strongbox key from the Drowned Captain, opened the box and took a Kothringi Keystone on a chain. I brought it to Nesh-Deeka, who did not know it but said the carving is Kothringi. The Kothringi were the silver-skinned people of the marsh, all dead of the Knahaten Flu. The Chime-Keepers of Toklea, a town on the river fork in the Tulmek Washes, keep what is left of their lore, and their elder should know what the keystone is. She paid me another 100 gold. She said the Unbound have not been to the wreck and lost the trail at Gideon. When I asked how she knew, she only said "we listen". I still carry the keystone, the Old Silver Setting, the Collector note, the smuggler key, the captain's key and about 500 gold. I have no lockpicks. Next lead: take the keystone to the Chime-Keepers at Toklea. I still do not know what the keystone does, where the real Eye is, or how Nesh-Deeka knows what the Unbound do. The Unbound and the Collector (Ennodius Vanin) are still hunting the Eye.
